layout_and_spacing.general_spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) to prevent data clutter
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense data, forms, and paragraphs. Top-level headers can be left-aligned for a technical dashboard feel.

surface_strategies.nav_bar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/60 border-b border-white/10. Sticky at top with z-50.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#0D111A), 1px solid border (border-white/10), no soft shadows. Apply a subtle neon glowing border on hover.
surface_strategies.buttons: High contrast. Primary CTA uses Sui Blue (#3898FF) background with white text. Hover state brightens to Cyan (#00F0FF).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) with border color changing to primary blue. Buttons glow or brighten.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders with subtle pulse (bg-white/5) instead of standard spinners.

component_guidelines.technology: React JS (.js files only), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives
component_guidelines.customization: Strip Shadcn's default styles. Replace rounded borders with sharp (rounded-none) or slight (rounded-sm) edges to fit the technical Web3 aesthetic.
component_guidelines.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, high-end technical look.
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) configured with dark mode colors and neon green/blue lines.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text over glowing elements must use text-shadow or dark text colors.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements. E.g., data-testid='connect-wallet-button', data-testid='stake-nft-button', data-testid='unstake-button', data-testid='admin-apy-input', data-testid='staked-balance'.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue background with wavy lines, perfect for subtle dashboard background overlays (opacity 10-20%)
3D glowing blue cube, use as a placeholder for the Voxx NFTs or default tier rewards visuals
Futuristic control panel, good for the admin dashboard header visual

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React (.js files). Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Integrate multi-wallet connections for Sui Wallet, Suiet, and Slush. Authentication must be wallet-only.
Implement the UI with a strict 'Electric & Neon' Web3 dark mode: Background #05050A, Cards #0D111A, Primary accents #3898FF to #00F0FF.
Use 'Unbounded' font for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body data.
Build a Staking Dashboard to view NFTs, earnings (Points system), and stake/unstake actions with rewards calculation.
Build an Admin Panel to manage APY and multiple reward tiers based on staking duration.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='connect-wallet-btn').
